# P4 handoff to R1 — culture-reagent (FBS / cell-line) contamination strands

**From:** P4 (serology / antigen) pass, 2026-11-06.
**To:** R1 agent. File only; do not edit R1 unless the R1 agent takes it up.

P4 was asked to trawl for sources bearing on serology/antigen provenance. In doing so it turned
up a cluster of references that are **not** about serology assay design but about the *culture
reagent itself* — FBS and repository cell lines carrying pestivirus material. These are R1/R4
territory (serum practice, cell-line provenance, non-Isolation standards), so they are handed off
here rather than kept in P4. Full texts would go to `r1_…/refs/`; none are committed here.

## Why this matters to R1 (one line, no elaboration)

The culture reagent (FBS, and repository cell lines) is itself a documented carrier of
pestivirus-label material, independent of any inoculum. This bears on Isolation-practice
provenance and on "virus-free"/negative-control claims — R1/R4 scope, not P4.

## What P4 keeps

P4 retains only the *serology/antigen-assay* strand (Beier 2004, Xu 2022, Saliki 1998,
Kainulainen 2026, Ellis 2023, Sherlock 1986, Browne 2025, Krishnan 2022). See
`p4_serology_antigen/P4_reading_notes.md`.

*End of handoff. R1 agent: pick up at your discretion.*
